items.stem: A knowledge-base answer invents a refund window that appears in no source document. Which change most directly reduces this failure?

options.text: Require the generation step to answer only from retrieved passages and cite them
options.rationale: Correct: constraining generation to retrieved, cited context is the primary guardrail against ungrounded claims.
A larger embedding may help retrieval slightly but does not stop the model inventing unsupported facts.
Higher temperature increases variability and typically makes fabrication more likely, not less.
Storing more chunks changes retrieval volume, not whether the model stays within retrieved context.

items.explanation: Correct: constraining generation to retrieved, cited context is the primary guardrail against ungrounded claims.

items.stem: Which TWO practices make a RAG evaluation repeatable rather than anecdotal? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Maintain a fixed gold set of questions with expected source passages
options.rationale: Correct: a stable gold set lets you measure change over time.

options.text: Review only the three answers that looked wrong last week
options.rationale: Cherry-picking failures is not a repeatable measure of overall quality.

options.text: Record retrieval hit-rate and answer faithfulness on each run
options.rationale: Correct: tracked metrics turn evaluation into a comparable signal.

options.text: Change the chunking and the model at the same time between runs
options.rationale: Changing two variables at once prevents attributing any change to a cause.

items.explanation: Correct: a stable gold set lets you measure change over time.

items.stem: An executive can retrieve finance documents they should not see. Where is the control best applied?

options.text: Document-level access filtering at retrieval time
options.rationale: Correct: filtering retrieval by the caller's permissions stops unauthorized content reaching the model.

options.text: A disclaimer in the system prompt
options.rationale: A prompt disclaimer does not prevent unauthorized passages being retrieved.
Chunk size is unrelated to who may see a document.

items.explanation: Correct: filtering retrieval by the caller's permissions stops unauthorized content reaching the model.
